jcr:title: XprESS ENT dilation system
jcr:description: XprESS ENT dilation system delivers control and versatility for balloon dilation to address chronic rhinosinusitis or Eustachian tube dysfunction.<sup>1-2</sup>

hero.head: XprESS ENT dilation system
hero.content: The XprESS ENT dilation system delivers a unique combination of control and versatility for ENT balloon dilation. Its familiar seeker-based design and tip malleability provide the tactile feel you are accustomed to and the flexibility you need to address both chronic rhinosinusitis or Eustachian tube dysfunction patients.<sup>1-2</sup>

section_title.description: Designed based on the tools you know and use²
section_title.title: Features and benefits

text_copy_copy.text:
The XprESS ENT dilation system offers surgeons a unique set of features and benefits.1 These features include:

  • A slim profile that enables easy visualization, access and navigation of narrow anatomy
  • The integrated Path Assist LED light fiber delivers light confirmation through trans-illumination and excursion, eliminating the need for an extra light source and cables
  • Malleable tip that allows for customization based on patient anatomy to treat the frontal, maxillary, sphenoid sinuses and the eustachian tube
  • Compatible with the Stryker ENT navigation system, allowing for navigated confirmation*
  • Compact balloon sizes for use across patient populations including pediatrics

*The XprESS LoProfile dilation device is trackable with the Stryker ENT navigation system during balloon sinus dilation procedures, when used with the TGS guidewire

text.text:
1 | Designed for performance 

Ergonomically engineered to fit naturally in your hand, XprESS enables one-finger advancement while supporting your technique for stability, control and precise positioning in procedures.9

text_copy.text:
2 | Compact design 

A slim, 1.25mm profile enables easy visualization and precise access in narrow and pediatric anatomy.¹

3 | Light confirmation 

Integrated Path Assist LED light fiber delivers light confirmation through trans-illumination and excursion, eliminating the need for an extra light source and cables.

4 | Tactile feel 

Malleable, seeker-based tip inspired by traditional ENT instruments designed to support precise placement and atraumatic navigation.

5 | Distal markers 

1cm and 2cm depth markings provide visual cues on placement.

standaloneimage.alt: Traditional ENT instruments: Olive tip probe, Frontal sinus seekers, Frontal curette, Double ball probe vs. XprESS ENT dilation device: Rounded ball tip delivers tactile fell vs. XprESS ENT dilation system

text.text: The XprESS instrument technology is designed for both office and OR procedures. XprESS takes inspiration from traditional ENT tools and other FESS instruments, such as the frontal seeker, frontal curette, olive tip probe and double ball probe. The slim profile of the XprESS device is designed to enable easy endoscopic visualization and placement of the device.
